claim: ESP-IDF v6.1 OTA guide (ESP32): OTA needs two app slots (ota_0, ota_1) and an otadata partition; with CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE a new app boots in ESP_OTA_IMG_PENDING_VERIFY and is rolled back on the next reset unless it calls esp_ota_mark_app_valid_cancel_rollback(); anti-rollback refuses apps whose security version is lower than the eFuse value (one-way); signed OTA images can be verified even without hardware Secure Boot

MCUboot design: primary and secondary image slots; swap-using-scratch, swap-using-move, overwrite, direct-xip and RAM-load strategies; a 'test' swap boots the new image and MCUboot performs a 'revert' swap on the next boot if the image never confirms itself; images are verified against an embedded key hash; downgrade prevention by version or a hardware security counter

NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 'Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security' (September 2023) addresses OT security while 'addressing their unique performance, reliability, and safety requirements'; OT covers programmable systems that monitor or control physical processes (industrial control, building automation, transportation, physical access control)
